notes.title: New Legendary Girl: URIEL
notes.content:
🌟 URIEL Has Arrived in Eros Fantasy! 🌟

Meet Uriel, the newest Celestial hero, bringing powerful healing and support to your team!

[list]
[*] Basic Ability: Every 5 seconds, heals the weakest ally and adds a barrier if she's Celestial. Casts two extra times with a short delay.
[*] Special Ability: Heals all allies, removes negative effects, and clears Dark Marks for Celestial teams.
[*] Passive Skills: Uriel starts combat with Immortality if there's another Celestial ally and becomes Untargettable when hit with lethal damage. She also boosts Tenacity for allied Celestials and clears debuffs when their health is low.
[/list]

✨ LEGENDARY EVENT ✨
Uriel’s event launched 14 hours ago! To unlock her, gather 5 Celestial heroes with 5 stars.

Are you ready to add this divine healer to your team?
